assets.prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph for a square 2048x2048 social ad: an in-use hair care scene in a sunlit bathroom, shot straight on at ledge height. Reference images: @front shows the exact product, a matte sage green bottle with a white flip-top cap. @back is for reference only. Reproduce the product exactly as in @front, with the same shape, proportions, matte soft-touch sage finish, white flip-top cap with the thumb notch facing front, and colour. The front label faces the camera, with the words printed directly on the bottle in quiet cream lettering, spelled exactly and in the same typefaces and positions as @front: "VERDA", "Hydrating", "Conditioner", "detangles without weigh-down · 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz". The bottle stands upright in the left third of the foreground on a pale limestone ledge with visible natural pitting. It is in sharp focus, about half the frame height or slightly less, photographed in this scene rather than added to it. It casts a soft shadow falling to the right that matches the sunlight, with a true wet reflection in the damp stone beneath it. Fine water droplets and a few thin runs of water cover the bottle and cap. Scattered water beads sit on the limestone. In the right two thirds, in the mid-ground and clear of the bottle, a person is seen from behind and slightly to the side, with no face in frame. They wear a thick white cotton terry towel wrapped high around the shoulders. Both hands comb their fingers slowly through the long, wet lengths of dark hair, working a smooth, glossy white cream conditioner through the strands. The cream sits in silky streaks along the hair, and there is no foam or lather. The fingers are relaxed and natural, with natural skin texture, no jewellery, no painted nails and no tattoos. Nobody touches or overlaps the bottle. Background: a wall of rich, saturated ochre limewash plaster with soft mottling, kept soft through shallow depth of field but keeping its full warm colour. Crisp palm-leaf shadows fall across the wall. Lighting: hard, warm, low golden-hour sun from a window on the left, raking across the ledge and the bottle, with highlights warm and never blown out on the label. Shadows fall to the right, with strong contrast between lit and shadowed areas. Faint warm steam hangs in the air. Camera: level with the ledge at about mid-bottle height, so only a thin sliver of the ledge top is visible. Never look down onto the ledge. 50mm lens at f/2.8, with the foreground ledge and bottle sharp and the hands reading clearly. Palette: deep ochre, warm honey light, pale limestone, white cotton and sage. Editorial magazine colour grade, warm and full. No props. No other products, packaging or text. No face, no jewellery, no pale beige walls, no flat even light and no washed-out look.
